Madness and greed fuel a compelling game between three self-centered people. A man who never retreats, seeking power and fortune; a corrupt, cold-hearted lady seeking control; and an opportunistic businessman who manipulates everyone to maintain his position through shady dealings. The brilliant lawyer Abdel Sattar El Kaf is involved in a tragic car accident, and as a result, he enters a coma that lasts for 20 years. When he wakes up from his coma, he finds himself faced with strange things and concepts that he has never witnessed before. He must keep up with the times and the developments that have occurred but finds it difficult to do so.

In the village of Konoha, where powerful ninja fighters roam, a troublesome young man Naruto wreaks havoc wherever he goes. After graduating from the ninja academy, he believes that he knows everything, especially when he meets the grandson of the Hokage , the ruler of the village. But what will happen when Naruto unleashes a rare power by stealing the ancient seal scroll?

Father Time decides to turn five executives into baby animals, in an attempt to fix all the environmental disasters that have occurred, but the difficulty lies in turning them back into humans, which requires searching for gemstones that can help them return to the human world.

Monkey D. Luffy ate a Devil Fruit when he was young that granted him rubber attributes. At the age of 17, he decides to go on a journey to sail the seas in search of the legendary treasure One Piece that Gol D. Roger mentioned before his execution. He is accompanied by a team of 8 people. What does fate have in store for them?
